title: Challenge set
summary: Situations picked to run against your usual style.
intro: Every situation here calls for a particular approach. The set is chosen from your behavior results, so it leans toward situations where your usual style may not fit.

questions.prompt: You're assembling a crib for your baby. The instructions are detailed.
questions.need: a child's safety depended on following instructions

options.label: Follow the instructions step by step
Figure it out as I go

questions.prompt: You have a free afternoon in a city you've never visited.
questions.need: there was nothing to lose by exploring

options.label: Wander and see what I find
Follow a guidebook plan

questions.prompt: You're training a nurse on medication dosing.
questions.need: a learner's mistake could hurt someone

options.label: Explain the exact procedure and check it back
Ask questions so they work it out

questions.prompt: Your teenager asks you to just fix their essay's argument for them.
questions.need: someone needed to build their own thinking

options.label: Rewrite the argument for them
Ask questions until they see the gap

questions.prompt: Your family is planning a vacation. Everyone has opinions.

options.label: Decide and book it
Plan it together, even if it takes longer

questions.prompt: You witness a car accident. Bystanders are frozen.
questions.need: an emergency needed someone to take charge

options.label: Point at people and give each a job
Ask if anyone knows first aid and wait

questions.prompt: Your roommate's habits have bothered you for months.
questions.need: an issue had been building for months

options.label: Bring it up calmly this week
Keep putting up with it

questions.prompt: At a wedding, a relative makes a mildly annoying comment about you.
questions.need: the moment wasn't worth a fight

options.label: Call it out
Let it go for the day

questions.prompt: Your gut says a product is fine, but a few customer reports suggest a safety defect.
questions.need: a hunch conflicted with warning signs

options.label: Investigate before deciding
Trust my read of the product

questions.prompt: Someone at your table starts choking.
questions.need: there was no time to gather facts

options.label: Act immediately
Make sure of what's happening first

questions.prompt: An editor you hired says your book's opening chapter drags.
questions.need: you had asked an expert for their judgment

options.label: Revise it
Keep it as it is

questions.prompt: A relative criticizes how you raise your kids, based on a single visit.
questions.need: the criticism came from a thin view of the situation

options.label: Rethink my approach
Hold to what I know works

questions.prompt: A colleague is drowning and asks if you can take a project. You're already past capacity.

options.label: Take it on
Decline and help them find another option

questions.prompt: You notice water leaking in the office. Facilities is someone else's job.
questions.need: a small problem would grow if no one acted

options.label: Deal with it or call it in now
Assume someone else will report it

questions.prompt: A volunteer on your team keeps missing shifts. They're otherwise great.

options.label: Ask what's going on and help
Replace them

questions.prompt: A top performer on your team falsified a report.

options.label: Apply the consequences
Coach them and move on

questions.prompt: You're launching a new product with no playbook and a small test audience.
questions.need: learning fast was cheaper than planning

options.label: Ship small versions and learn
Plan every detail first

questions.prompt: Your business needs a successor within two years.
questions.need: someone needed to grow into your role

options.label: Start handing real decisions to a promising junior
Keep key decisions with me until I'm ready
